title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention combines Gaussian weights based on character distance with scaled dot-product attention, applies directional masks for forward/backward encoding, and uses multi-head architecture to capture information from different dimensions.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention mechanism modifies standard scaled dot-product attention by incorporating a Gaussian weight matrix that assigns higher weights to adjacent characters based on distance, ensuring local relationships are emphasized. It further integrates directional masks (triangular matrices) for forward and backward encoders to capture directional information, and employs a multi-head architecture to capture information across different dimensions, enhancing the model's ability to represent input sequences effectively.
